| engine | exact | close | OFF | gaps | -- | no ref |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| proj4rs | 23 | 3 | 3 | 0 | 25 | 0 |
| proj4rs-main | 37 | 0 | 2 | 1 | 14 | 0 |
| proj4rs-wasm | 37 | 1 | 2 | 0 | 14 | 0 |
| proj-core | 4 | 1 | 2 | 0 | 47 | 0 |
| wbprojection | 11 | 1 | 28 | 6 | 8 | 0 |
| geodesy | 6 | 0 | 5 | 0 | 43 | 0 |
| proj4js | 18 | 1 | 5 | 13 | 17 | 0 |
| math.gl | 29 | 3 | 4 | 1 | 17 | 0 |

| verdict | meaning |
|---|---|
| exact | exact: forward within 1 mm and inverse within 1e-08 deg of PROJ at every point PROJ answers |
| close | close: forward within 1 m and inverse within 1e-05 deg |
| OFF | off: larger differences somewhere (worst shown) |
| gaps | gaps: agrees where it answers, but gives no result at some points where PROJ does |
| -- | unsupported: the engine refused the projection string |
| no ref | no-reference: PROJ refused this projection, so there is nothing to judge against |

(known) marks a difference recorded with a reason in [projections.json](../../suites/projections/projections.json).
